narrative: The facing leaf of the same opening. No column rules it. The account page is still open beside it. Your hand is at the top line. Lower on the same leaf. The lines are not summed. Nothing on the leaf names a price. The last note on the leaf. The pen is set down. The bottom of the coffer is not mentioned.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the facing leaf and set the pen down.
